text:
The 2006 win was a 33rd Annie Award (February 2006) for Storyboarding in an Animated Television Production, credited to Lauren MacMullan for the episode "The Deserter," according to an AWN list of final winners. This corrects my earlier answer, which missed it, but the only source I found is that AWN list and I haven't checked it against annieawards.org. The series' other Annie wins came at the 34th (2007) and 36th ceremonies, not 2006.

CONFIDENCE: 65
